# Activity

1 route. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/activity` | List a workspace's activity feed |

### GET /api/v1/activity

List a workspace's activity feed

Newest-first collaboration and posting activity — publishes, schedules, approvals, comments, campaigns and team changes. Rows from one composer session collapse into a single entry whose `data.accounts` lists every channel. Cursor-paged rather than offset-paged: the feed grows at the head, so an offset would re-show rows as new activity lands mid-paging.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |
| `limit` | integer (min 1, max 100, default 50) | no |  |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page. |
| `type` | one of (one of `"post.published"` | `"post.scheduled"` | `"approval.requested"` | `"approval.approved"` | `"approval.rejected"` | `"comment.added"` | `"campaign.created"` | `"campaign.completed"` | `"member.invited"` | `"member.joined"` | `"streak.reached"` | array of one of `"post.published"` | `"post.scheduled"` | `"approval.requested"` | `"approval.approved"` | `"approval.rejected"` | `"comment.added"` | `"campaign.created"` | `"campaign.completed"` | `"member.invited"` | `"member.joined"` | `"streak.reached"`) | no | Filter by event type. Repeat for OR (e.g. `?type=post.published&type=approval.approved`). |

**Responses**

- `200` — A page of activity
  - `ActivityFeed`
    - `entries`: array of `ActivityEntry`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `type`: one of `"post.published"` | `"post.scheduled"` | `"approval.requested"` | `"approval.approved"` | `"approval.rejected"` | `"comment.added"` | `"campaign.created"` | `"campaign.completed"` | `"member.invited"` | `"member.joined"` | `"streak.reached"`, required
      - `actor`: `ActivityActor`, required — Null for system-generated events (a campaign reaching its end date, a streak milestone).
        - `id`: string, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `image`: string | null, required
      - `targetType`: string | null, required
      - `targetId`: string | null, required
      - `data`: object, required — Display payload; shape varies per `type` (see ActivityDataMap in @orbitwrite/core/activity). Every field is a copy taken at write time, so a deleted post's activity line still renders.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
    - `nextCursor`: string | null, required — Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
